name: Jaeger pilot flight motion helpers
description: Four native helper clips. Cruise PBR poses reviewed. Camera-relative flight integration and transitions remain runtime work.
brief: Kiln-authored sustained cruise, bank left/right and brake animation helpers for the original articulated Jaeger.
